title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second

translated_title: 我该选择哪种努力程度？论大语言模型智能体中推理努力的经济学
translated_abstract: 生成式模型越来越多地提供一种“推理努力”设置，允许用户调节推理时的计算量，以更高的成本换取可能提升的性能。用户必须在尚不知道额外推理是否有帮助的情况下选择努力程度，而且即使一次成功的运行也无法揭示所购买的努力是否必要。因此，推理努力是一种“信任品”：买方只能观察到结果，却无法评估其所支付计算带来的边际价值。在这项工作中，我们在四个基准上测量了努力程度对专有模型和开放权重模型的反事实影响，这些基准涵盖单次调用推理任务和长时程智能体任务。研究结果表明，努力程度并不能稳定保留低努力程度所能解决的任务，可能导致过度支出，并可能改变轨迹行为。首先，我们发现尽管更高的努力程度在总体上可以提高准确率，但它在低努力程度所能解决的任务上却经常失败。其次……
tldr: 该论文首次将大语言模型的“推理努力”刻画为一种“信任品”，通过在四个基准上量化不同努力程度的反事实效应，发现提高努力程度虽能总体提升准确率，却经常无法解决低努力已能解出的任务、可能造成计算成本超支并改变智能体的行为轨迹，为推理努力的选择提供了经济学视角的实证依据。
en_tdlr: This study frames LLM reasoning effort as a "credence good" and quantifies its counterfactual effects across four benchmarks, showing that higher effort, while improving aggregate accuracy, often fails on tasks that lower effort can solve, may overspend compute, and can alter agentic trajectory behavior.
